WITH periods AS (
  SELECT 'current' AS period, TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AS start_ts, TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AS end_ts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'base', TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT p.period, COALESCE(SUM(i."total"), 0) AS revenue
  FROM periods p
  LEFT JOIN "public"."invoice" i
    ON i."invoice_date" >= p.start_ts
   AND i."invoice_date" < p.end_ts
   AND i."billing_country" = 'USA'
  GROUP BY p.period
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN b.revenue = 0 OR b.revenue IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND((c.revenue - b.revenue) / b.revenue * 100, 2)
  END AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM revenue c
CROSS JOIN revenue b
WHERE c.period = 'current' AND b.period = 'base';
